plan.design: Score single-substitution candidates with ESM-2 score_variant (E1), prioritizing the most conservative substitution per position (BLOSUM62) as position-tolerance probes, then deepen scoring at the most tolerant positions. Rank all scored candidates by ESM-2 delta and query the evidence oracle (ProteinGym SDA_BACSU_Tsuboyama_2023_1PV0, E3) on the highest-ranked candidates. Compare ESM-2 rank vs measured fitness.
plan.observation_metric: Spearman/concordance between ESM-2 delta rank and measured fitness among oracle-queried candidates; measured fitness of the ESM-2 top-1 (E3).
plan.refutation_condition: If among 20 oracle-queried top-ESM-2 candidates the measured-fitness maximum is not among the top ESM-2 ranks and ESM-2 rank is uncorrelated/negatively correlated with measured fitness, H1 is refuted.
